parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.sport, t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registration_deadline, (t.registration_deadline < NOW()) AS closed, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, p.upi_id, p.upi_name, p.qr_key, p.accept_cash, p.note AS payment_note, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'sort_order', d.sort_order, 'min_age', d.min_age, 'max_age', d.max_age,   'squad_min', d.squad_min, 'squad_max', d.squad_max, 'max_teams', d.max_teams, 'entry_fee', d.entry_fee,   'approved', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED')))  FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('code', tm.code, 'name', tm.name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key, 'my_role', mm.role,   'players', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('member_id', x.id, 'user_id', x.user_id, 'name', COALESCE(u.name, x.guest_name),      'photo_key', COALESCE(u.photo_key, x.guest_photo_key), 'position', COALESCE(x.position, s.role), 'is_guest', x.user_id IS NULL,      'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(u.birthdate, x.guest_birthdate), t.start_date), 'jersey_number', COALESCE(x.jersey_number, u.jersey_number)))    FROM team_members x LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = x.user_id LEFT JOIN app_user_sports s ON s.user_id = x.user_id AND s.sport = tm.sport    WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.role <> 'COACH')))  FROM team_members mm JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = mm.team_id  WHERE mm.user_id = viewer.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN') AND tm.sport = t.sport) AS teams, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', e.id, 'team_code', tm.code, 'team_name', tm.name, 'division_id', e.division_id, 'status', e.status,   'amount', e.amount, 'payment_method', e.payment_method, 'reject_reason', e.reject_reason,   'players', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id)))  FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id  JOIN team_members mm ON mm.team_id = tm.id AND mm.user_id = viewer.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN')  WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id) AS my_entries, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('user_id', ep.user_id, 'team_code', tt.code, 'team_name', tt.name)) FROM tournament_entry_players ep  JOIN tournament_entries e2 ON e2.id = ep.entry_id JOIN teams tt ON tt.id = e2.team_id  WHERE ep.tournament_id = t.id AND ep.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e2.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'WAITLISTED')) AS taken FROM tournaments t LEFT JOIN tournament_payment_details p ON p.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
